identify.title: Log in or sign up
identify.subtitle: Enter your mobile number or email. No account yet? We'll create one here in under a minute.
identify.label: Mobile number or email
identify.invalid: Enter an Iranian mobile number or a valid email.
identify.hintEmail: You'll log in with this email's password.
identify.privacy: Your number and details are used only to log you in and follow up on your case, and are never shared with anyone else.
identify.terms: By continuing you accept Scorize's <terms>terms and conditions</terms>.
identify.useMobile: To log in with an SMS code, enter your account's mobile number.

otp.title: Enter the verification code
otp.subtitle: We texted a {{length}}-digit code to <id>{{phone}}</id>.
otp.label: Verification code
otp.resent: A new code has been sent.
otp.incomplete: Enter all {{length}} digits of the code.
otp.neverShare: Never share this code with anyone, including Scorize staff. We never ask for your login code by phone.

password.title: Welcome back
password.subtitle: Enter the password for <id>{{email}}</id>.
password.label: Password
password.useSms: Log in with an SMS code instead

register.title: Let's create your account
register.subtitle: There's no account for <id>{{identifier}}</id> yet. Fill in three fields and we'll send you a code.
register.phoneHint: We'll text a verification code to this number.

serverErrors.email: This email is invalid or already registered.
serverErrors.phone_number: This number is invalid or already registered.

register.emailHint: Your contract and written documents are sent to this email.
register.terms: By creating an account you accept Scorize's <terms>terms and conditions</terms>.

resetSent.title: Check your email
resetSent.body: We sent a link to set a new password to {{email}}. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.hint: At least 8 characters. Avoid simple or common passwords.
reset.rejected: This password wasn't accepted. Choose a longer, less common one.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new one.
reset.doneBody: You can now log in with your new password.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.sessionExpired: Your login timed out. Please start again.
errors.invalidOtp: That code isn't right. Try again.
errors.otpExpired: This code has expired. Get a new one.
errors.otpTooManyTries: Too many attempts. Get a new code in a moment.
errors.otpTimeout: Your previous code is still valid. You can get a new one when the timer ends.
errors.captcha: The security check failed. Try again.
errors.inactive: This account is disabled. Contact support.
errors.duplicate: An account with this email or number already exists. Log in with it instead.

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Next time just log in with your mobile number and an SMS code; no password needed.
